QuickCare Urgent Care - Discharge Instructions
Date: 08/19/2026
Seen by: Paul Grant, PA-C

You were seen today for: Sprained right ankle.

Self care:
Rest, ice, compression and elevation for 48 hours.
Ibuprofen 400 mg every 6 hours with food as needed for pain.
Use crutches as needed.

Follow up with your primary care provider in 5-7 days.
Go to the emergency room if your toes become numb, cold, or blue.
